title: Kinetic energy at A
description: Essential: Correct calculation of kinetic energy using E_k = ½mv² with given m=70kg and v=10m/s.

title: Potential energy at A
description: Important: Correct calculation of gravitational potential energy using E_p = mgh with h=10m and g=10m/s².

title: Total mechanical energy
description: Essential: Correct sum of kinetic and potential energies at point A (E_A = E_k + E_p).

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: Recognition that mechanical energy is conserved from A to B (E_A = E_k at B).

title: Velocity at B
description: Essential: Correct calculation of v_B from conservation: v_B = √(2E_A/m).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Proper use of SI units (J for energy, m/s for velocity) throughout solution.

title: Algebraic simplification
description: Optional: Correct simplification to exact form v_B = 10√3 m/s rather than decimal approximation.

title: Sign error in energy
description: Pitfall: Using negative potential energy or incorrect sign in energy summation.

title: Velocity formula error
description: Pitfall: Using v_B = √(2gh) instead of v_B = √(2E_A/m), forgetting initial kinetic energy.
